bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg=deploy-postgres-1
sql="SELECT r.paid_message_id,CASE WHEN l.seller_user_id=788044853 THEN 'KNOWN_MASTER_IS_SELLER' ELSE 'KNOWN_MASTER_NOT_SELLER' END AS author_role,l.status, r.status, l.price_stars, CASE WHEN l.paid_video_file_id=l.sample_file_id THEN 'EXPOSED_SAMPLE_SAME_FILE' ELSE 'DISTINCT_FROM_FREE_SAMPLE' END FROM videobot_post_receipts r JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id WHERE r.paid_message_id IN (4691,4701,4714) ORDER BY r.paid_message_id;"
docker exec -e "SQL=$sql" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -F "|" -c "$SQL"'
